help.search: Queries job boards live (France Travail, Emploi.nc…) and returns what matches your keywords. No AI: fast and up to date, but you need the right words.
help.smartSearch: AI searches by meaning, not just words: “developer” also finds “software engineer”. It draws on already-collected offers, then moves the most relevant ones to the top.
help.matchProfile: Starts from your CV instead of a query: AI finds offers that look like your profile and gives each a match score. Requires an uploaded CV.
help.matchAdvanced: Like “Matches”, but deeper: AI combines meaning and keywords, then re-reads each offer to refine the ranking. More accurate, a little slower.
help.fetchJobs: Paste a company careers page URL (Greenhouse, Lever…) to import its openings. No AI: direct retrieval.
